purpose: Actual browser gameplay animation review; separate from normal QA and GPU profiling.
videoScope: Full Playwright session, including loading, puzzle completion, return to island, camera adjustment, and the gait review window. This is not a trimmed 10–15 second clip.
frameRateLimit: Playwright recordVideo samples/resamples browser output. Video playback FPS and screenshot cadence are not native engine FPS and must not be reported as performance evidence.
inputMethod: Actual mouse and keyboard only: right-mouse orbit, W, W+D, D, and released-key stops. Diagonal/side input reveals knee and ankle motion that camera-relative W alone hides.
timingLimit: Event times are relative to navigation; recording begins slightly before navigation. They are approximate video navigation aids, not exact frame timestamps.
